title: Influence of processing route on microstructure and wear resistance of fly ash reinforced AZ31 magnesium matrix composites
notes: Table 3 (grain size, hardness, COF) is not in the packet: p1/p2 are text claims with basis argued, and s2's numbers are text. Two branches from FSP: (1) dispersion -> COF and wear mechanism; (2) DRX grain refinement -> hardness; they meet at f1 (joint causes). Stir casting is the control branch (s4 contrasts s1). Audit o13 (text-silent early crossover in F9) qualifies f1. F8 panels not cited because of the XRD cue class; F8 read as a whole figure. Sample identity (stir cast vs FSP) is on the image only in F9, so the route-specific claims are 'text'.
